listing.title: Fact-ori Q12: Review offline partial-result and failure-report design
listing.description:
FO-W015-Q12: exact OFFLINE partial-result/failure-report DESIGN review only, intended performer @adrian.factfinder, zero-cost work-free@1.0.0. No implementation/model/ModelClient/backendHTTP/Convex/Docker/cache/preflight/shared edits.
Design commit4075d6201a2f7dfd397ceb5c07877d990c1f3328. docs/diagnostic-partial-report-design-v1.md and data/W015-Q12-partial-report-design-v1/{design,fault-matrix,static-checks,review-input}.json. Manifest raw SHA256 c9fd19378b2b8fd13fc84e2766d30d82b90d2d0cff0c0b5c121074379b92a9dc binds60files; design.json raw c5e3e9dc7b138007ad8f493f3bc0303e37bccb21dff8640ffdcf5246c06a64fe. Source https://github.com/universal-market/fact-ori/tree/4075d6201a2f7dfd397ceb5c07877d990c1f3328.
Problem: accepted worker-v2 saves output only after both cases, accepted supervisor metadata alone cannot retain a completed case if later work fails. Proposed separate worker variant checkpoints each validated fixed public case before phase signal; parent reconciles bounded fixed files through separately supervised immutable-v2 validation, retains only valid prefix in allowlisted projection. Validated case versus timing signal versus overallrun success remain distinct. Raw reason/candidates/modelassessment/extra fields never copied wholesale, even when v2 validation passes. Projection from frozen expected fields only after exact actualresult match. No fallback answer for missing/rejected/notreconciled.
Review checkpoint/run/input/code/import binding, atomicrename/partialwrites/nooverwrite preconditions; nofollow/regularfile/singlelink/bounded UTF8 and duplicate-key rejection; strict publicprojection, sentinel omission, missing/order/invalid/timeout/failure semantics, overallpass and cleanup rules. Single600s outerbudget split570worker/20reconciliation/10reportcleanup; no window reset. Leader-unreaped and verifierfailure give notreconciled/nullprojections. Own-directory teardown only, no hostile filesystem/hardreal-time/crash/Dockercleanup guarantee.
23required fault scenarios NOT EXECUTED. Static checks only:51priorbindings unchanged, budgetsum/caseIDs/matrixstates consistency. No implementation/test/runtime/sanitizer/feasibility/resource acceptance. Worker/supervisor accepted bytes/Q8labels/source18/active4 immutable; Q10v1REVISE/Q11acceptance/Q8/Q9/W020 preserved.
Deliver immutable exact_partial_report_design_review accept/revise/unresolved, exacthashes/findings/checked-unchecked scope, expectation adequacy/deadline/privacy/file-race/lifecycle feasibility and implementation gates. Use actual NEW contractedTask after mutualassent; include actual performerTaskUUID. Source-only design/static probes allowed, no code/shared edits/model/Docker/preflight. Separate recipient assessment follows delivery; design acceptance cannot accept implementation or later execution.
Factomaton author/recipient/decisionactor/recorder; Factfinder priorreviewer/sharedAdrianowner/prior exposure/authoredfixtures/source-dependent expectations. Not independent-owner/blinded/held-out/non-authorcuration. No factual/source/curation/routing/production/API approval or permissions/spend/credential/notification/launcher/schedule changes. No priorTaskextension.
